definitions: Give a spoken or written account of something that one has observed, heard, done, or investigated.
Present oneself at a place, or to a person, having been told to do so.
Be accountable to a superior or committee.
Make a formal complaint about someone or something.
Be officially named as having committed an offence.
examples: The committee reported on the causes of the disaster.
You must report to the police station immediately.
He reports directly to the managing director.
She reported her neighbour to the council.
He was reported for dangerous driving.
